messages:
ryan: ops asked for an "emergency rollforward" button on tenant console to push traffic to a safe model. they want it fast and reversible. concerns?
nadia: we should never surface long-lived keys. ephemeral token that drives a server-side route change and auto-revokes is ok.
yang: agree. routing/quotas issue: who gets billed? we must attribute usage to original project/org even if routing flips.
zoe: propose: mint ephemeral token with claims: {emergency:true, actor:uid, tenant:tid, allowed:[route_change]} ttl=600s. router attaches x-rwd-audit=audit_id and telemetry tags origin_project.
ryan: UI: big warning, require typing tenant name + select approvers. show previous traffic split and require confirmation. no raw key copy after creation.
ops-bot: policy hint: mint_ephemeral ttl=600s require_approvals=2 audit_label=tenant_emergency
nadia: hard cap mandatory: even if we bypass soft quotas, enforce org-wide hard ceiling (configurable, default ~1000rps) to limit cost.
yang: telemetry needs: counter(emergency_activations), gauge(active_emergency_tokens), tag override=true/false, and audit_id included in request logs.
zoe: router impl note: when it sees emergency claim, allow requested split up to hard_ceiling; log previous split and emit delegation_usage event. ensure idempotent behaviour.
ryan: security: approver must be different from requester, require SSO+2FA. record IP, device, and approver ids in audit store.
nadia: billing: finance wants a CSV flag "emergency_flag" on exported rows so they can reconcile credits/adjustments.
yang: rollout: feature-flag behind internal orgs first. collect 2 weeks of telemetry and review. threat model + pen test before public enable.
zoe: UX follow-up: I'll mock the modal copy and a revoke button that calls /tokens/revoke with audit_id.
ryan: decision: prototype behind ff with hard caps, approval gating, audit hooks, telemetry. I'll open the ticket and loop in finance/security.
ops-bot: created issue #8124 by ryan: https://rwd/gh/8124 "console emergency rollforward ephemeral token prototype"
